decisions.reason: The field clauses did not explicitly lift the fixed component vectors to tangent vectors at every field point. The inertial chart provides a canonical constant extension, so this is a nonfatal typing omission. Clause (d) now gives n_q=n^a partial_a|_q and s_q=s^a partial_a|_q on a specified open domain, and specifies smooth symmetric tensor fields. Clause (c) extends screen dual covectors by e^i(v)=eta(e_i,v), making the ambient reconstruction well typed. Normalization, projections and amplitudes are unchanged.

The opening supplier restatement calls n=du the wave covector although the supplier calls k=-omega n the wave covector. This is nonfatal terminology: clause (a), the proof and the Remark already distinguish both objects and give the correct signs. Changed only the opening name to the differential of the phase coordinate; also parenthesized (partial_3 u)^2 and stated partial_3^2 u=0 in proof 2.1 to remove an ambiguous derivative expression.

L1 omitted the X in V_0 hypothesis of the unique-TT-representative supplier. The proposed diagonal counterexample has Z=0 and trace one, confirming that the unconditional restatement is false. This is nonfatal for the example: step 1.1 already checks all four harmonic contractions for the actual matrix, so the supplier applies. Repaired L1 with X in V_0 and omega nonzero, and made step 1.2 explicitly use and cite step 1.1; the matrix, representative and gauge transformation are unchanged.

The fourth datum bullet explicitly binds g(lambda):=eta+lambda h; it does not assert equality with the metric of the supplied tuple (epsilon_1,h,q). The latter may have nonzero q. The extra Lorentzian requirement is on the newly defined truncated metric near K, and D explicitly evaluates G(eta+lambda h), so its cosmological term and Einstein tensor use the same metric. All detector formulas use that same local binding. First-order coefficients depend only on h, not q, by the flat coefficient formulas. No hypothesis requires the original remainder-bearing family to be the detector metric. The rejection conflates two locally defined uses of g; no item edit is justified.

With Box=-partial_0^2+partial_3^2 on these profiles, both second derivatives are -omega^2 f, so the time and spatial contributions are +omega^2 f and -omega^2 f. L1 displayed them in the reverse order. The scalar equality was still zero (the judge overstates its falsity), and neither harmonicity nor the curvature and strain calculations fail; this is a nonfatal sign-decomposition defect. Repaired L1 by giving both second derivatives and the correctly signed Box formula for cosine and sine. L2 now also explicitly retains the zero-profile branch rather than writing 1/(2M) without M>0.

reviews.reason: Checked eta normalization, positive rest-space restriction from lem-gr-observer-projection-decomposition, screen trace subtraction, TT reconstruction and bilinear rotation formulas. Constant extensions preserve the pointwise algebra and do not introduce variable observers. This is adjudicator review of the repair, not independent acceptance.

Checked each clause: du=(1,0,0,-1), eta-dual=-T, k=-omega du, the future/past/zero alternatives, chain-rule profile Hessians, TT trace and divergence, and integral curves (x^0+sigma,x^1,x^2,x^3+sigma). All conclusions follow from explicit smooth coordinate calculus without physical premises. This is adjudicator review of the repair, not independent acceptance.

Recomputed trace four, all four harmonic contractions, Z=(1,2,0,1), and X-k tensor Z-Z tensor k=diag(0,1,-1,0). The supplied triangular system is invertible for omega=1 and guarantees uniqueness only after V_0 membership. Chain-rule differentiation of xi_b=Z_b sin(k.x) gives the stated TT harmonic field. Reviewed current screen supplier: constant chart extensions do not change the amplitude splitting. The owning contract now cites step 1.1 as an input to 1.2.

Checked the datum tuple, local metric definition, Lorentzian neighborhoods, stress-energy zeroth-order compatibility and linearized source, SI dimensions, and D against the exact specified source family. With the locally defined TT metric, the arm radicand is |delta|^2(1+lambda a_delta); compact q intervals make the integral finite and its first derivative one half the integral of a_delta. TT g_00=-1 and g_0i=0 give the stated proper-time normalization. The clock/free-fall reading remains conditional; no empirical premises enter. Current screen constant extensions preserve the TT terminology. The unchanged item guard equals the assignment before guard.

Recomputed the four first derivatives, equal second derivatives, Box cancellation, boundedness from sin^2+cos^2=1, TT trace/divergence, and the Lorentzian M>0 and M=0 branches. Curvature is -one half F-double-prime with the stated positive 0101 and 0102 coefficients and negative 0202 coefficient. Screen arm contractions are a cos(omega u) and b sin(omega u), giving exactly the displayed path-length strains and phase-zero values. SI phase and curvature units and the zero-source, Lambda=0 compact residual qualifications remain intact. The updated null-phase supplier changes only terminology and derivative parentheses; all used clauses remain valid. No measured data or inference enters.
